fullPassage: On the traditional family smallholding, labour and domestic life are more closely interwoven than they are in a mill town, where the industrial is one thing and the domestic another. Peasants have children, for example, for much the same reasons that anyone else does, but also because they will grow up to work on the land, take care of the elderly, and eventually inherit one's modest allocation of acres. As well as looking cute, they represent labour-power, a welfare system, and the continued survival of the farm. In modern civilisation, by contrast, it is hard to say what children are for. They don't work, for example, and some of them are not particularly decorative. They are expensive to keep and not always rational. Caring for them as infants is one of the most difficult forms of labour known to humankind. Given all this, it is surprising that the modern human species manages to reproduce itself at all. Yet again there is no question of the utility of children among peasants and tenant farmers.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

On the traditional family smallholding, labour and domestic life are more closely interwoven than they are in a mill town, where the industrial is one thing and the domestic another.

(A) As well as looking cute, they represent labour-power, a welfare system, and the continued survival of the farm. In modern civilisation, by contrast, it is hard to say what children are for.

(B) They don't work, for example, and some of them are not particularly decorative. They are expensive to keep and not always rational. Caring for them as infants is one of the most difficult forms of labour known to humankind.

(C) Peasants have children, for example, for much the same reasons that anyone else does, but also because they will grow up to work on the land, take care of the elderly, and eventually inherit one's modest allocation of acres.

det.korean: (C)→(A)→(B) 순서: 전통 농가 자녀의 실용적 역할 → 노동력+복지+농장존속+현대 전환 → 현대 아이의 무용 구체화
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (C)→(A)→(B): 도입문에서 전통 농가의 노동·가정생활 통합 언급 → (C) 농민이 자녀를 갖는 이유(노동, 노인 돌봄, 상속) → (A) 'they'가 (C)의 children을 지칭하며 노동력·복지·농장생존 추가 설명 + 'by contrast' 전환 → (B) 'They don't work'으로 현대 아이들의 무용 구체화

❌ ① (A)→(B)→(C): (A)의 'they'가 도입문 직후에서 지칭 불명확
❌ ② (A)→(C)→(B): (A)의 'looking cute'와 'they represent'가 먼저 나오면 children 언급 없어 지칭 모호
❌ ④ (C)→(B)→(A): (B)의 'They don't work'은 현대 아이들인데, (C) 직후에 오면 전통 농가 아이들로 오독
det.tip: 대명사 'they'의 지칭 대상과 'by contrast' 전환어를 추적하세요.

questions.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? "In other words, the practical benefits of having children in the modern world are far from obvious."

det.korean: 현대 아이들의 실질적 혜택이 불분명하다는 요약문은 (③) 뒤가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③: 바로 앞 'it is hard to say what children are for'에서 현대 아이의 용도 불명 언급 → 삽입문 'practical benefits are far from obvious'가 이를 환언(In other words) → 뒤 'They don't work'이 구체적 근거로 이어짐

❌ ①: 도입문 직후로, 아직 현대 아이에 대한 언급 없음
❌ ②: 전통 농가 아이의 역할(노동력, 복지)이 이어지는 맥락이라 현대 무용 요약이 부적절
❌ ④: 이미 'expensive to keep and not always rational'까지 열거된 뒤라 'In other words' 총괄이 늦음
det.tip: 'In other words'는 앞 내용을 환언하는 전환어입니다. 바로 앞 문장과 의미적으로 등가인 위치를 찾으세요.

✅ ②: 'labour-power, a welfare system, and the continued survival of the farm'으로 전통 농가 역할 정리 직후 → 삽입문이 'clear-cut role'로 되짚으며 대비 전환 → 'In modern civilisation, by contrast'로 자연스럽게 연결

❌ ③: 이미 'by contrast' 전환 뒤라 같은 대비를 중복 서술

정답: They are expensive to keep and not always rational
주어(They) + 동사(are) + 보어1(expensive to keep) + and + 보어2(not always rational)
'expensive to keep'은 'to부정사의 형용사적 용법(tough 구문)'으로 '유지하기에 비싼'의 의미. 'not always'는 부분부정으로 '항상 ~인 것은 아닌'의 의미.
det.tip: tough 구문: 형용사 + to부정사 (It is expensive to keep them = They are expensive to keep)
